newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST-Polish zloty seen at 3.3817 vs dlr end-97.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Polish zloty seen at 3.3817 vs dlr end-97.

text.p: The Polish zloty is seen easing against the dollar by the end of the year and the prediction is less pessimistic than last month, according to a Reuter poll of the country's 26 largest banks.
By the end of 1997 the zloty is expected to fall to 3.3817 to the dollar versus Thursday's fixing of 3.1105, the poll showed.

The end-1997 prediction is a mean average of forecasts that ranged between 3.1800 and 3.7000. Last month, banks predicted a fall in the Polish unit to 3.4057 at year-end with forecast ranging from 3.2000 to 4.0000.

Banks estimated the zloty would fall to an average of 3.1226 against the dollar at the end of April, with a range from 3.0890 to 3.1500 and to 3.4951 to the dollar in April 1998, with a range of forecasts from 3.2200 to 4.1500.
